div.span: Phase 0: Data Preprocessing

Adam Optimizer
lr = 1e-4
Only updates: cluster1, cluster2,
cluster_probe weights

Train for 5000 steps
batch_size = 16
Dropout p=0.1 on features

Save checkpoint
experiments/stego_colocated/P1/
stage2/checkpoints/seed0/final.pt

Contrastive Correlation Loss
(correspondence_weight = 1.0)

Positive Intra-Image Loss
Same image, different crops
Weight: 0.67, Shift: 0.18

Positive Inter-Image Loss
Same image, augmented view
Weight: 0.25, Shift: 0.12

Negative Inter-Image Loss
Different images (20 negatives)
Weight: 0.63, Shift: 0.46

Feature Correlation (fd)
fd = cosine_sim(feats_a, feats_b)
Pointwise centering applied
(frozen, no gradients)

Code Correlation (cd)
cd = cosine_sim(code_a, code_b)
(trainable, gradients flow)

loss = -cd × (fd - shift)
Forces code similarity to match
frozen feature similarity

Cluster Probe Loss
ClusterLookup(70, 8)
K=2 classes + 6 extra = 8 clusters
Learns cluster assignments

Total Loss
= corr_loss + cluster_loss
(CRF weight = 0.0, rec_weight = 0.0,
aug_alignment = 0.0, text_align = 0.0)

cluster1: Linear Projection
Conv2d(768 → 70, kernel=1×1)
Output: [B, 70, 14, 14]

cluster2: Nonlinear Projection
Conv2d(768 → 768, 1×1) → ReLU → Conv2d(768 → 70, 1×1)
Output: [B, 70, 14, 14]

code = cluster1 + cluster2
Residual addition
Output: [B, 70, 14, 14]

Frozen BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16
microsoft/BiomedCLIP-PubMedBERT_256-vit_base_patch16_224

Patch Embedding
224÷16 = 14×14 grid of patches
Each patch → 768-dim vector

12 Transformer Blocks
Multi-Head Self-Attention + FFN
Extract from shallow_layer_n=2
(deepest 2 blocks: 11-12)

Output: feats tensor
Shape: [B, 768, 14, 14]
These features are FROZEN — no gradients flow here

Convert to Hounsfield Units
HU = pixel × RescaleSlope + RescaleIntercept

Raw DICOM Files
(512×512, 16-bit)

Body Crop
Binary threshold HU > -500 → largest blob
→ bounding box extraction

Resize to 224×224
Bilinear interpolation

Duplicate to 3-channel RGB
(BiomedCLIP expects RGB input)
